audit.whatIsWrong: The two chart layers disagreed on six of seven rows (full said Skill on 0,1,2,3,4,6 while content said Cassiopeia/Akali), and the content chart gave Cassiopeia 6/7 at a 47.4% win rate.
audit.why: Grounded chart: 850 Noxious Blast vs 550 Five Point Strike wins levels 1-3 outright; levels 4-5 even out once Twilight Shroud (20s at rank 1) makes her untargetable and blanks Twin Fang; level 6 is Akali's on Perfect Execution; first item is yours on Seraph's/Liandry's; 2+ items is even because grounding and Shroud cancel each other.
audit.corrected: Rows 0,1,2 -> Cassiopeia; row 3 -> Skill; row 4 -> Akali; row 5 unchanged (Cassiopeia); row 6 -> Skill. Every side edit paired with its win[N] and its why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Akali's ultimate was called 'Shadow Dance' in whys[4], spikes[1], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[1]. That name does not exist in her kit.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon lists her R as Perfect Execution (120/90/60s, 675 range, two casts, the recast executes).
audit.corrected: Every occurrence replaced with Perfect Execution and the real 120s rank-1 cooldown added where it makes the advice concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] claimed Twilight Shroud 'only masks vision, not your Twin Fang lock'. That is backwards and is the decisive interaction of the matchup. Separately, breakdown text credited Twin Fang with true damage, which it does not deal.
audit.why: Riot text on Twilight Shroud: she becomes 'invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'. Twin Fang is a targeted spell, so it cannot be cast into the shroud. Noxious Blast is a ground-targeted zone and does still land. Twin Fang's kit entry carries no trueDamage flag.
audit.corrected: Shroud now correctly stated as untargetability that blanks Twin Fang while Q still lands; the true-damage claim removed from late. Miasma's grounding is now stated against both Shuriken Flip's return dash and Perfect Execution's leap.

audit.whatIsWrong: 13 lint findings: 8 misgendered fields, 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 cooldowns field with no digit. report[8] also told you to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain' when Akali has no heal in her kit.
audit.why: Akali is female per champ-gender.js; Assassin's Mark is an auto-attack reset, not a heal, so Grievous Wounds is the wrong purchase to prioritise here.
audit.corrected: All fixed below; the anti-heal clause replaced with Zhonya's against Perfect Execution.

edits.before: Akali's Twilight Shroud only masks vision, not your Miasma zone or Twin Fang lock — keep poking into the smoke since Noxious Blast doesn't need to see her to land.

edits.before: Her Shadow Dance ult gives a dash-reset all-in that can burst you down before you can Twin Fang stack twice, so hold Petrifying Gaze as a deterrent rather than a poke tool once she hits 6.

edits.before: Once you have Rylai's or Liandry's, your Miasma slow plus Twin Fang stacks shut down her energy-based combo before she can reach a second Shadow Dance charge.

edits.before: Cassiopeia wins lane from level 1 through 5 — Noxious Blast poke chunks Akali for free since she has no ranged answer, and Twilight Shroud doesn't stop your Q from landing because it isn't a vision-based ability. She has to play passively and farm energy for a level 6 all-in rather than trade into you directly.
edits.after: Cassiopeia wins levels 1-3 — Noxious Blast reaches 850 to her Five Point Strike's 550, so the poke is free. Levels 4-5 even out once Twilight Shroud is up: she is untargetable inside it and Twin Fang will not fire, though ground-targeted Noxious Blast still lands. She farms energy for a level 6 all-in.

edits.before: Level 6 flips to her — the moment she gets a second Shadow Dance charge, she can dash in, burst, and dash out before your Miasma slow or Twin Fang stacks matter, especially if you've been poking aggressively and sitting low. Play the level 6 spike cautiously and hold Flash rather than farming it away.
edits.after: Level 6 flips to her — Perfect Execution's recast dashes through and executes, so she enters, bursts, and leaves before Miasma or Twin Fang matter, especially if you have been poking aggressively and sitting low. Play the level 6 spike cautiously and hold Flash rather than farming it away.

edits.before: With a completed first item, Cassiopeia's zone control and true-damage DPS from Twin Fang stacks outlast her short assassin combo — she can't stay in your Miasma cloud long enough to burst you if you have the HP buffer from earlier poke advantage. She's forced into pick mode off cooldowns and vision rather than straight lane duels.
edits.after: With a completed first item, Cassiopeia's zone control and Twin Fang's magic DPS outlast her short assassin combo — grounded inside Miasma she cannot Shuriken Flip back out, and Twin Fang heals you off the poison she is standing in. She's forced into pick mode off cooldowns and vision rather than straight lane duels.
